Driving Empowerment Action & Learning

DEAL began with one book drive in April 2023. Later, it was formed into the Brophy DEAL Club, and today is known as deal.inc, an internationally impactful 501(c)(3) youth-led nonprofit.

Our story

In April 2023, a book drive for the Navajo Nation showed a small group of students just how much impact a stack of donated books could have on a community that needed them.

That drive became the Brophy DEAL Club, and the club became the foundation for what DEAL is today: a network of students, schools, and partners working to put books and educational resources into the hands of people who lack access to them.

What we do

DEAL collects, organizes, and distributes donated books and educational materials to communities that face barriers to access. Every book we redistribute serves two purposes: expanding access to literacy and education, and reducing the environmental waste created when usable books are thrown away instead of reused.

Programs

  1. 01

    Book drives

    Collection events that gather donated books, textbooks, and educational materials from schools, families, and community partners.

  2. 02

    Distribution partnerships

    Coordinated deliveries to tribal communities, schools, hospitals, and literacy organizations across the U.S. and abroad.

  3. 03

    Chapter expansion

    Student-led chapters, starting with Brophy College Preparatory, that organize local drives and bring DEAL to new schools and regions.

  4. 04

    Fundraising events

    Community fundraisers that cover shipping, storage, and distribution costs.

Our Impact Today

Books donated
Patagonia jackets donated
Native American tribes served
Literacy NGO partnerships
Countries reached

Partners include the Navajo Nation, San Carlos Apache, Hualapai, and Pascua Yaqui tribes; Chinle Planting Hope, Kids Need to Read, and EDRising; and schools and hospitals across Arizona, California, and Texas, with deliveries reaching Eswatini, Rwanda, Vanuatu, and Mexico.
